name: Grid Pooling (Max Pooling over Points)
definition: A differentiable operation that projects point cloud features onto a 3D voxel grid by performing max pooling within each cell. It maps N points with C-dimensional features to a grid of size WxHxD with C-dimensional features, tracking indices for backpropagation.
summary: Grid Pooling aggregates point features into a voxel grid via max-pooling, uniquely tracking the winning point index to enable differentiable backpropagation unlike hard voxelization.
